acyclicity.reason: A global roster containing normalized full/capsule/adoption record pins that themselves hash-bind that roster creates a content-hash cycle. The final eager raw Store index is not a causal subject roster.
rules: R0 may contain only complete already-born inputs preceding the first normalized event. It cannot contain itself, any current normalized record hash-binding R0, or a future output placeholder.

A new full proof is born before its capsule; capsule binds the complete full-proof fact3; adoption later binds capsule and full fact3 as direct late subjects and retains complete earlier subject coverage. These are distinct records/events unless a separately adopted exact joint event permits sharing.

Later prior-only roster R1 may include complete R0 and already-born normalized full/capsule/adoption outputs, but no record that hash-binds R1. Each additional roster is a real bounded raw record, counted by both eager Stores and wherever decoded.
Every index shares the exact roster pin fixed in the containing whole record. Isolated row reuse or cross-roster/envelope transplant refuses. Preserve all Root/adoption context and chronology links.
No future SHA/size placeholders, no event identity replaced by a nonauthoritative context nonce, no omitted review_pin/full_proof subjects.

reference_semantics.prior_subject_ref: Only fields explicitly declared subject_ref may contain an exact builtinint, nonbool,0<=n<len(roster.pins). Resolve directly to the validated read-only roster pin value. Ordinary integers/JSON values are never interpreted as references.

reference_semantics.semantic_edge_policy: Every resolved/direct pin still undergoes its field-specific role/cap/wholebody/path/type/actor/context/time/proof joins.
